verdict.rationale: Kick documents core close primitives — reconciliation workflows, period locks that function as accountant sign-off/finalization, double-entry journal entries, and an accrual ledger tier — but there is no documented unified 'close checklist' feature that ties reconciliations, accruals, and sign-offs together into one trackable list. missing for 10: an explicit month-end close checklist/dashboard, explicit accrual entry workflow beyond a plan-tier mention, and evidence of tracking sign-off status across multiple close tasks in one view.
